messages:
maria.g: Heads-up — I found a case where the /payments route was marked exempt from sampling but debug output included raw card_last4 in a trace. Not cool. Need a safer debug flow.
kevin.l: yikes. can you paste the log snippet?
mar ia.g: short snippet (sanitized): `{"route":"/payments/charge","user_id":"u_123","card_last4":"1234"}`. It came from an adhoc debug flag we turned on last week.
tara: is this the exempt route logic we discussed in the RBAC doc? sounds like a privilege escalation of the debug flag. :warning:
kevin.l: yeah, exempt routes + ephemeral debug flags was the combo we feared. proposal: add an "inspect mode" that is timebound, auditable, and requires a specific admin role. only displays redacted values by default, and requires a one-time approval to unmask.
julian.k: +1. we should log who requested unmasking and for how long. store approval event in audit log and include TTL.
sre-bot: deploy pipeline check: any change to redaction/exempt flow requires a config-schema bump and an e2e in staging. :robot_face:
maria.g: rough config prototype:```json
{
  "routes": [
    {
      "path": "/payments/*",
      "logging": {
        "sampling": "100%",
        "redaction": "default",
        "inspect_mode": {
          "enabled": true,
          "ttl_seconds": 3600,
          "requires_role": "audit_inspector",
          "audit_event_name": "inspect_request"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
kevin.l: question: do we keep "exempt" semantics anywhere? i'd prefer to remove global exempt and replace with inspect_mode + allowlist for very small infra-only routes.
tara: agree. exempt is too blunt. inspect_mode gives a controlled path. also add a console UX: button that starts a 1-hour session, prompts for justification, sends approval to pager/Slack and writes audit event.
maria.g: UX sketch: modal with justification textarea + checkbox "I confirm data will be viewed only for debug". on approve, console calls internal API /v1/inspect/start with role token.
julian.k: on the API side: require a signed policy token and emit an audit_id. responses with sensitive fields should include a header X-Audit-Id and a flag masked:true/false. we can leverage existing sampling middleware.
kevin.l: implementation concerns: ensure KV cache and prefix cache don't leak unmasked data. also any dumped KV should be scrubbed.
tara: ops-bot can we add a short-lived KMS-used encryption key per inspect session? ops-bot: yes, can generate session keys with 1h TTL and rotate.
sre-bot: infra checklist: schema migration, RBAC addition, audit pipeline, console modal, e2e tests, staged rollout with feature flag.
maria.g: can we also add a console-only "view-redacted-only" so most sessions never reveal full PII? helps reduce accidental unmasking.
kevin.l: SGTM. next steps: I'll draft an RFC for the API contract + audit events. Maria, can you own the console modal mockups? Tara, can you own RBAC mapping? Julian will spec the header/audit-id behavior. ops-bot: ops to prepare KMS flow.
maria.g: yes, will have mocks by EOD Friday.
tara: I'll map roles and a migration plan by Monday.
julian.k: will write API contract PR by Monday too.
kevin.l: thanks all. if we find more ad-hoc flags that bypass redaction, we'll quarantine them until this lands. :thumbsup:
